name: Gulf of Execution and Gulf of Evaluation
axiom: Keep intent, action, and visible result close enough that people never have to guess.
trigger: A button gives no sign it worked, so people click again and create duplicate orders.

checklist.text: Mark clickable elements with a signifier users can see before they hover or click.
Change the control and show a status line as soon as an action is accepted.
State in the error message what happened, which object it concerned, and the next step.
Ask users to describe what the system did after each action; treat a wrong answer as a gulf.

antiPattern.violation: Clicking Process leaves the cursor unchanged and shows nothing, so the operator clicks three times and files three orders.
antiPattern.remediation: The button disables itself, shows a spinner, and relabels to Processing until the result appears.

parametricParams.caption: TWO GAPS: TO ACT, AND TO SEE
